# Server 2025 RC0 evidence

Synthetic fixtures from [GitHub Actions run 39834396093](https://github.com/zerotrustgarage/tools/actions/runs/39834396093),
commit `93b11840ce3dd5aa249ac8c12c24c631824377f8`, English GitHub-hosted `windows-2025`.

Files ending in `.base64` preserve raw bytes; decoding is lossless. Console bytes can mix
encodings. `native-log.base64` is the authoritative UTF-16LE log. JSON files contain captured
observations, environment provenance and native network experiment results. These fixtures
contain only generated test data. They do not establish support for other Windows builds or locales.
